provenance: Related by family in the project brief that founded this archive. To be re-captured in Larry's own words.
text: Around August 1965, Larry was in Japan. He personally remembers seeing a notice or article in Stars and Stripes saying he had been killed.
hold: Held 2026-09-15 on the family's decision: an early summary in his son's words, from before Larry's own accounts were being recorded, and since overtaken by them. Kept off the site; the record is unchanged.
researchNotes: One of the most important stories in the project. Not treated as confirmed until the original Stars and Stripes item or Army documentation is located, but preserved exactly as given.
